他没有提任何意见，系统已经向他道了谢。
信夹在第三十天那一页，不会有人翻到。

他认为这是三个选项里唯一诚实的一个：系统确实已经了解了，只是了解的不是信的内容。
三十天一个人都不投诉，这件事本身是不是值得投诉。但他的工位上没有这个选项。

restrained-satire.voice_reason: Y, like the reference, lets judgment fall out of externally observed physical detail and indifferent bystanders (碳粉, 茶杯盖碰杯沿, 椅面上没弹回的印子, 没有人抬头) with no narrator gloss, whereas W keeps stepping in to explain its own irony ("唯一诚实的一个", "安静得像一个设计得很成功的产品").
restrained-satire.notes: W, X and Z are essentially the same text with tiny edits: X drops the closing simile "安静得像一个设计得很成功的产品" and so reads slightly more restrained; W and Z are nearly indistinguishable (Z has "有耐心" vs W "更有耐心" and "那人" vs "那个人"), the W/Z order is close to arbitrary. V is otherwise strong and close to the reference in method (concrete detail, pass-the-letter chain, ending on the erased shoe-polish ring), but it has the director dictate the "已了解" choice, which shifts the decisive act away from 周河; it also invents the letter's content (an eviction for a 文明岗亭) and implies the stall is gone at the end, which is permissible fictional texture but leans toward adding an outcome. Without the violation V would rank second overall.
